import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Find the station with highest mean NO2 in June 2025
query = text("""
SELECT hsaq.station_id, aqs.name_en, AVG(hsaq.no2) as mean_no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY hsaq.station_id, aqs.name_en
ORDER BY mean_no2 DESC
LIMIT 10
""")
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(df)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get Mong Kok station coordinates
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lon, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 14
""")
station = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(station)

lon = station['lon'].values[0]
lat = station['lat'].values[0]

# Find dominant land_category within 500m buffer
query_landuse = text(f"""
SELECT lu.land_category, SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(lu.geometry, ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lon}, {lat}), 4326), 500)))) as intersection_area
FROM land_use_zone lu
WHERE ST_DWithin(lu.geometry, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lon}, {lat}), 4326), 500)
GROUP BY lu.land_category
ORDER BY intersection_area DESC
LIMIT 10
""")
landuse_df = pd.read_sql(query_landuse, engine)
print(landuse_df)

# Count HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION sensitive areas within 1000m
query_health = text(f"""
SELECT COUNT(*) as health_count
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
  AND ST_DWithin(
    ST_Centroid(geometry),
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lon}, {lat}), 4326),
    1000
  )
""")
health_df = pd.read_sql(query_health, engine)
print(health_df)
